info.title: MAM Xchange API
info.description:
API specification for MAM (Media Asset Management) Xchange services.
This API provides comprehensive functionality for managing assets, projects,
authentication, and various media operations through Xchange integration.

All API responses follow: version, status, msg, data. Success: status=0, msg="ok".
Error responses include errorMsg and errorString.

Authentication using an external system is supported through a master token:
- Master Token for administrative access and elevated permissions

post.description:
Creates a new Smartbin or updates an existing one. Same endpoint for both:
- **Create**: omit smartbin[id]. Required: smartbin[smartbinName].
- **Update**: include smartbin[id] with the bin ID to modify.

Form encoding: smartbin[key] for bin properties.

**filterFields** is a flat structure where each key is a metadata field name in Xchange.
For fields with match options, use three values:
- **value** (string): The filter value
- **matchOption**: startsWith, endsWith, contains, or exact
- **comparator**: like, not like, =, or !=

Example: smartbin[filterFields][Approval Status][value]=Approved,
smartbin[filterFields][Approval Status][matchOption]=startsWith,
smartbin[filterFields][Approval Status][comparator]=like        

Optional: userIds[], groupIds[] for access.

Grants a user access to one or more Smartbins.
Request body must be application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Example: user_id=22076&bin_id[]=208281

200.description: User added to Smartbin access successfully

delete.description: Removes a user's access to one or more Smartbins. Use query format bin_id[]=42&bin_id[]=43&user_id[]=101.

parameters.name: bin_id[]
parameters.description: Smartbin IDs to remove access from

parameters.name: user_id[]
parameters.description: User IDs to remove access (first element is the target user)

200.description: User removed from Smartbin access successfully

get.description:
Search for media annotations (markers, subclips) using SearchRequest query parameters.
Use SearchRequest[equalsAnd][field], SearchRequest[likeOr][field], SearchRequest[sorters][field] encoding.

parameters.name: SearchRequest[equalsAnd][_parent_recordid]
parameters.description: Filter by parent record ID (exact match)

parameters.name: SearchRequest[concatWithAnd]
parameters.description: Combine filters with AND (1) or OR (0)

post.description:
Creates a new marker/subclip or updates an existing media annotation.
Request body must be application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Use MediaAnnotation[key] form encoding.

delete.description:
Deletes a media annotation (marker or subclip).
Send as query params or x-www-form-urlencoded body. Use MediaAnnotation[id], MediaAnnotation[mediaRecordId], MediaAnnotation[parentRecordId].

CookieAuth.name: access_token
CookieAuth.description: Access token as a cookie (alternative to Authorization header)

MasterTokenAuth.name: Authorization
MasterTokenAuth.description:
JWT access token or Master Token. XChange expects the **raw token** as the header value.
Do not prefix with "Bearer " — send only the token (e.g. the value of accessToken from login).
Example: Authorization: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...

accessToken.description: JWT access token for API authentication

assetResourceFilePath.description: File system path to the resource

binId.description: Bin ID to place asset in

filePath.description: Path to the file to fulfill the placeholder

metadata.description: Additional metadata for the fulfilled asset

MediaAnnotationCreateForm.description:
Flat form schema for x-www-form-urlencoded. Use these exact property names.
Example: MediaAnnotation[parentRecordId]=58e319c05f97c--1&MediaAnnotation[type]=1&MediaAnnotation[fields][Name]=Marker+001

send_fork.description: Whether to sync to Fork (0 or 1)

MediaAnnotationDeleteForm.description:
Form schema for delete. Use query params or x-www-form-urlencoded body.
Example: MediaAnnotation[id]=4&MediaAnnotation[mediaRecordId]=d6ee8f45c00b5--1&MediaAnnotation[parentRecordId]=58e319c05f97c--1

MediaAnnotation.description: Media annotation (marker or subclip) on an asset

binId.description: Bin ID to add asset to

Smartbin.description:
Smartbin object for create/update. Form encoding: smartbin[smartbinName], smartbin[filterFields][key], etc.
Create: omit id. Update: include id with bin ID.

id.description: Smartbin ID. Required for update; omit for create.

filterFields.description:
Flat structure. Key = metadata field name in Xchange. For match options use value (string),
matchOption (startsWith, endsWith, contains, exact), comparator (like, not like, =, !=).
Simple fields: smartbin[filterFields][_is_container]=1

mediaCategories.description: Media categories filter (VIDEO, AUDIO, IMAGE, DOCUMENT, PROJECT, etc.)

daysOld.description: Days old filter (assets uploaded within this many days)

isContainer.description: When 1, this Smartbin is a container only. 0 = searchable bin with filter criteria.

isHideable.description: When 1, this Smartbin is not displayed in the manager config UI. 0 = visible.

ApiResponse.description: Standard API response. All API responses follow this structure.

data.description: Response payload; shape varies by endpoint

errorMsg.description: Error message when status indicates failure

errorString.description: Error details when status indicates failure

SmartbinResponseData.description: Created or updated Smartbin returned in data

filterFields.description: Key = metadata field. Value = object with value, matchOption, comparator

_is_container.description:
When 1, this Smartbin is a container for other Smartbins only — it has no search/filter fields.
Use for organizing bins into folders. 0 = searchable bin with filter criteria.

_hideable.description:
When 1, this Smartbin is not displayed in the Smartbin manager config UI.
0 = visible in the manager.

filterFields.description:
Custom metadata/search criteria. Key-value pairs where keys are metadata field names
and values are filter values. Defines what assets match this Smartbin.

description.example: Videos uploaded in the last 30 days

SmartbinCreateRequest.description:
Create Smartbin request. Form encoding: smartbin[smartbinName], smartbin[parentId], etc.
Access arrays: userIds[0], userIds[1], groupIds[0], groupIds[1].

SmartbinCreateForm.description:
Flat form schema for x-www-form-urlencoded. Use these exact property names.
API accepts form-urlencoded only; JSON is not supported.
